subject: maths
title: Primary 3 Time: Seconds, Duration and the 24-Hour Clock
seo_title: P3 Time Worksheets: Free Primary 3 Maths on Duration and the 24-Hour Clock with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Measuring time in seconds; finding the starting time, finishing time or duration; 24-hour clock
meta_desc: Free P3 maths practice on time: seconds, minutes and hours, durations on time lines, start and finish times and the 24-hour clock. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: 1 h = 60 min and 1 min = 60 s, not 100. For pm times, add 12 to get the 24-hour time.
key_sub: 7.15 pm to 9.05 pm: 45 min + 1 h + 5 min = 1 h 50 min, and 7.30 pm = 1930.
body_html:
Seconds, minutes and hours

Very short things take seconds (s). A walk to the MRT station takes minutes (min). A school day takes hours (h). Time does not count in hundreds.

UnitIs the same as
1 min60 s
1 h60 min
1 day24 h
Change to minutes

1 h 25 min = ? min

1 h = 60 min. 60 + 25 = 85.

Answer: 85 min

Find the duration with a time line

The duration is how long something takes. Draw a time line. Jump to the next o’clock first, then jump the whole hours, then the minutes left. Add the jumps.

Find the start time or the finish time

To find the finish time, count on from the start time. To find the start time, count back from the finish time. When you pass 12 noon, am changes to pm.

Finish time

A quiz starts at 11.45 am. It lasts 30 min. When does it end?

11.45 am + 15 min = 12 noon. 30 − 15 = 15 min more makes 12.15 pm.

Answer: 12.15 pm

Start time

Siti reaches school at 7.20 am. Her walk takes 15 min. When did she leave home?

Count back 15 min: 20 − 15 = 5.

Answer: 7.05 am

The 24-hour clock

A 24-hour time always has 4 digits. am times keep the same hour: 7.30 am = 0730. For pm times, add 12 to the hour: 7.30 pm = 1930. We read 1930 as “nineteen thirty hours”.

12-hour time24-hour time
12 midnight0000
7.30 am0730
12 noon1200
12.20 pm1220
3.00 pm1500
7.30 pm1930
11.45 pm2345

Word problems with a bar model

Draw a bar for each time. Change hours to minutes so the units match.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
1 h 20 min = 120 min1 h is 60 min, not 100: 60 + 20 = 80 min
7.15 pm to 9.05 pm: 905 − 715 = 190 minDo not subtract times like ordinary numbers. Use a time line: 1 h 50 min
1930 = 9.30 pmTake away 12, not 10: 19 − 12 = 7, so 1930 = 7.30 pm
7.30 am = 730Always write 4 digits: 0730
11.45 am + 30 min = 12.15 amAfter 12 noon it is pm: 12.15 pm
12.20 pm = 2420Do not add 12 in the noon hour: 12.20 pm = 1220

faq.q: What do P3 students learn about time?
faq.a: In Primary 3, students measure time in seconds, change between hours and minutes, find the duration, start time or finish time, and use the 24-hour clock.

faq.q: How do I change 12-hour time to 24-hour time?
faq.a: Always write 4 digits. Keep the hour for am times (7.30 am = 0730) and add 12 to the hour for pm times (7.30 pm = 1930); 12 noon is 1200 and 12 midnight is 0000.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with time?
faq.a: Treating 1 hour as 100 minutes, for example working out 9.05 − 7.15 as 190 minutes. Use a time line and jump to the next o’clock first, which gives 1 h 50 min.

faq.q: Is the 24-hour clock in the MOE syllabus?
faq.a: Yes. The MOE 2021 Primary Mathematics Syllabus teaches the 24-hour clock in Primary 3, together with measuring time in seconds and finding durations.

items.q: How many seconds are in 1 minute?
items.e: 1 min = 60 s. The second hand goes once around the clock in 1 minute. (Not 100: time does not count in hundreds.)

items.q: How many minutes are in 1 hour?
items.e: 1 h = 60 min. The minute hand goes once around the clock in 1 hour. (Not 100: an hour is not like a hundred.)

items.q: Which unit is best to measure the time taken to blink your eyes?
items.e: A blink is over very fast, so we use seconds.

items.q: Which unit is best to measure the time taken to brush your teeth?
items.e: Brushing your teeth takes a few minutes, so we use minutes.

items.q: Which unit is best to measure the time taken to sleep at night?
items.e: You sleep from night until the morning, so we use hours.
The numbers on a stopwatch count in 5s. The hand points to 25, so it shows 25 s. (Not 5 s: on a clock the 5 is in that place, but this dial counts seconds.)
The hand is 2 small marks past the 40. Count 40, then 41, 42: 42 s. (Each small mark is 1 s.)

items.q: 2 h = ? min
3 min = ? s
Ali runs 100 m on Sports Day. About how long does he take?
items.e: A 100 m race is over in a short time, so it takes seconds: 20 s. 20 min is far too long for 100 m.

items.q: Mei Ling walks from the void deck of her HDB block to the MRT station. About how long does it take?
items.e: A short walk takes minutes, not seconds or hours: 10 min. (100 min is more than 1 h 30 min.)

items.q: A movie at the cinema lasts about ___.
items.e: A movie lasts a few hours: 2 h. 2 min is far too short and 20 h is almost a whole day.

items.q: 1 h 20 min = ? min
items.e: 1 h = 60 min. 60 + 20 = 80 min. (120 counts 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: 1 min 15 s = ? s
2 h 30 min = ? min
items.e: 2 h = 2 × 60 = 120 min. 120 + 30 = 150 min. (90 counts only 1 h. 230 counts 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: 90 min = ? h ? min
items.e: 60 min make 1 h. 90 − 60 = 30 min left. So 90 min = 1 h 30 min. (1 h 10 min would be 70 min.)
60 s make 1 min. 150 = 60 + 60 + 30, so 150 s = 2 min 30 s. (1 min 50 s counts 1 min as 100 s.)

items.q: 135 min = ? h ? min
items.e: 2 h = 120 min. 135 − 120 = 15 min left. So 135 min = 2 h 15 min. (1 h 35 min counts 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: Which is longer: 100 s or 2 min?
items.e: 2 min = 2 × 60 = 120 s. 120 s is more than 100 s, so 2 min is longer. (1 min is 60 s, not 100 s.)

items.q: Siti swims one length of the pool in 95 s. Ali takes 1 min 40 s. Who takes longer, and by how much?
items.e: 1 min 40 s = 60 + 40 = 100 s. 100 − 95 = 5. So Ali takes longer, by 5 s. (Ali, by 45 s counts 1 min as 100 s. Siti, by 55 s forgets Ali’s 1 min.)

sets.title: Finding the duration with a time line

items.e: 9.00 am to 9.40 am is 40 min.
10.15 am to 10.45 am is 30 min.

items.q: Hui Min practises the piano from 4.20 pm to 4.55 pm. How long does she practise?
items.e: 4.20 pm to 4.55 pm is 35 min.

items.q: Zhi Hao’s CCA is from 2.30 pm to 4.30 pm. Use the time line. How long is the CCA?
items.e: 2.30 pm to 3.00 pm is 30 min. 3.00 pm to 4.00 pm is 1 h. 4.00 pm to 4.30 pm is 30 min. 30 min + 1 h + 30 min = 2 h.

items.q: Priya’s school bus ride is from 6.45 am to 7.10 am. Use the time line. How long is the ride?
items.e: 6.45 am to 7.00 am is 15 min. 7.00 am to 7.10 am is 10 min. 15 min + 10 min = 25 min. (Not 65 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)
3.25 pm to 4.00 pm is 35 min. 4.00 pm to 4.05 pm is 5 min. 35 min + 5 min = 40 min. (Not 80 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Farah’s swimming lesson is from 5.40 pm to 6.15 pm. Use the time line. How long is the lesson?
items.e: 5.40 pm to 6.00 pm is 20 min. 6.00 pm to 6.15 pm is 15 min. 20 min + 15 min = 35 min. (Not 75 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Mrs Ng and her son eat lunch at a hawker centre from 12.45 pm to 1.20 pm. How long is lunch?
items.e: 12.45 pm to 1.00 pm is 15 min. 1.00 pm to 1.20 pm is 20 min. 15 min + 20 min = 35 min.

items.q: Jun Jie reads in the library from 11.40 am to 12.25 pm. How long does he read?
items.e: 11.40 am to 12 noon is 20 min. 12 noon to 12.25 pm is 25 min. 20 min + 25 min = 45 min. (Not 85 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: A school assembly and talk go on from 8.50 am to 10.20 am. How long is that?
items.e: 8.50 am to 9.00 am is 10 min. 9.00 am to 10.00 am is 1 h. 10.00 am to 10.20 am is 20 min. 10 min + 1 h + 20 min = 1 h 30 min. (Not 1 h 70 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Chloe’s family leaves home at 11.50 am and reaches Sentosa at 12.35 pm. How long is the journey?
items.e: 11.50 am to 12 noon is 10 min. 12 noon to 12.35 pm is 35 min. 10 min + 35 min = 45 min. (Not 85 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Lesson A is from 9.15 am to 10.00 am. Lesson B is from 2.40 pm to 3.30 pm. Which lesson is longer, and by how much?
items.e: Lesson A: 9.15 am to 10.00 am is 45 min. Lesson B: 2.40 pm to 3.00 pm is 20 min, and 3.00 pm to 3.30 pm is 30 min, so 50 min. 50 − 45 = 5. Lesson B is longer, by 5 min. (Lesson B, by 15 min uses 330 − 240 = 90 min, counting 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: A movie starts at 7.15 pm and ends at 9.05 pm. How long is the movie?
items.e: 7.15 pm to 8.00 pm is 45 min. 8.00 pm to 9.00 pm is 1 h. 9.00 pm to 9.05 pm is 5 min. 45 min + 1 h + 5 min = 1 h 50 min. (Not 1 h 90 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: A concert starts at 6.50 pm and ends at 8.25 pm. How long is the concert?
items.e: 6.50 pm to 7.00 pm is 10 min. 7.00 pm to 8.00 pm is 1 h. 8.00 pm to 8.25 pm is 25 min. 10 min + 1 h + 25 min = 1 h 35 min. (Not 1 h 75 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Mrs Lim’s baking class is from 1.55 pm to 3.10 pm. How long is the class?
items.e: 1.55 pm to 2.00 pm is 5 min. 2.00 pm to 3.00 pm is 1 h. 3.00 pm to 3.10 pm is 10 min. 5 min + 1 h + 10 min = 1 h 15 min. (Not 1 h 55 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Kavya’s class visits Gardens by the Bay from 10.00 am to 1.30 pm. How long is the visit?
items.e: 10.00 am to 1.00 pm is 3 h. 1.00 pm to 1.30 pm is 30 min. 3 h + 30 min = 3 h 30 min. (9 h 30 min comes from 10 − 1 = 9, but that does not work across 12 noon.)

items.q: Wei Ming’s family is at the Singapore Zoo from 11.30 am to 2.15 pm. How long are they at the zoo?
items.e: 11.30 am to 12 noon is 30 min. 12 noon to 2.00 pm is 2 h. 2.00 pm to 2.15 pm is 15 min. 30 min + 2 h + 15 min = 2 h 45 min. (9 h 15 min comes from 11 − 2 = 9, but that does not work across 12 noon.)

items.q: Sports Day is from 7.30 am to 12 noon. How long is Sports Day?
items.e: 7.30 am to 8.00 am is 30 min. 8.00 am to 12 noon is 4 h. 30 min + 4 h = 4 h 30 min. (Not 4 h 70 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.) (5 h 30 min counts the numbers 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 instead of the jumps.)

items.q: Mr Rahman drives from Singapore to Malacca. He leaves at 8.20 am and arrives at 11.10 am. How long is the drive?
items.e: 8.20 am to 9.00 am is 40 min. 9.00 am to 11.00 am is 2 h. 11.00 am to 11.10 am is 10 min. 40 min + 2 h + 10 min = 2 h 50 min. (Not 2 h 90 min: 1 h has 60 min, not 100, so do not subtract the times like ordinary numbers.)

items.q: Hafiz goes to sleep at 9.30 pm. He wakes up at 6.15 am the next morning. Use the time line. How long does he sleep?
items.e: 9.30 pm to 10.00 pm is 30 min. 10.00 pm to 6.00 am is 8 h. 6.00 am to 6.15 am is 15 min. 30 min + 8 h + 15 min = 8 h 45 min. (3 h 15 min comes from 9.30 − 6.15, but the time passes 12 midnight.)

sets.title: Finding the start time or the finish time

items.q: The English lesson starts at 8.00 am. It lasts 45 min. What time does it end?
items.e: Count on 45 min from 8.00 am: 8.45 am.

items.q: Recess starts at 9.30 am. It lasts 30 min. What time does recess end?
items.e: From 9.30 am, 30 min takes you to 10.00 am.

items.q: Siti reaches school at 7.20 am. Her walk takes 15 min. What time did she leave home?
items.e: Count back: 20 − 15 = 5. So it started at 7.05 am. Check: 7.05 am + 15 min = 7.20 am.

items.q: Xin Yi starts her art class at 2.15 pm. The class lasts 35 min. What time does it end?
items.e: 15 + 35 = 50. So it ends at 2.50 pm.

items.q: A CCA session ends at 5.00 pm. It lasts 30 min. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 30 min from 5.00 pm: 4.30 pm. Check: 4.30 pm + 30 min = 5.00 pm.

items.q: Raju starts reading at 10.40 am. He reads for 30 min. What time does he stop?
items.e: From 10.40 am, 20 min takes you to 11.00 am. 30 min − 20 min = 10 min more makes 11.10 am.

items.q: Arjun finishes his homework at 10.10 am. He worked for 25 min. What time did he start?
items.e: Count back 10 min to 10.00 am. 25 − 10 = 15 min more takes you back to 9.45 am. Check: 9.45 am + 25 min = 10.10 am.

items.q: Mdm Wong puts kaya toast in the oven at 4.50 pm. It bakes for 25 min. What time is it ready?
items.e: From 4.50 pm, 10 min takes you to 5.00 pm. 25 min − 10 min = 15 min more makes 5.15 pm.

items.q: A cooking show ends at 1.15 pm. It lasts 40 min. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 15 min to 1.00 pm. 40 − 15 = 25 min more takes you back to 12.35 pm. Check: 12.35 pm + 40 min = 1.15 pm.

items.q: The class starts a quiz at 11.45 am. The quiz lasts 30 min. What time does it end?
items.e: From 11.45 am, 15 min takes you to 12 noon. 30 min − 15 min = 15 min more makes 12.15 pm. After 12 noon the time changes from am to pm.
From 3.35 pm, 25 min takes you to 4.00 pm. 40 min − 25 min = 15 min more makes 4.15 pm.
Count back 10 min to 8.00 pm. 50 − 10 = 40 min more takes you back to 7.20 pm. Check: 7.20 pm + 50 min = 8.10 pm.

items.q: A bus leaves at 9.20 am. The trip takes 1 h 35 min. What time does it arrive?
items.e: Add 1 h first: 9.20 am → 10.20 am. Then add 35 min: 10.55 am.

items.q: Devi’s train ride ends at 3.05 pm. The ride takes 1 h 20 min. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 1 h: 3.05 pm → 2.05 pm. Count back 5 min to 2.00 pm. 20 − 5 = 15 min more takes you back to 1.45 pm. Check: 1.45 pm + 1 h 20 min = 3.05 pm.

items.q: A movie starts at 7.30 pm. It lasts 2 h 15 min. What time does it end?
items.e: Add 2 h first: 7.30 pm → 9.30 pm. Then add 15 min: 9.45 pm.

items.q: A school concert ends at 12 noon. It lasts 2 h 30 min. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 2 h: 10.00 am. Then count back 30 min: 9.30 am. Before 12 noon the time is am, not pm. Check: 9.30 am + 2 h 30 min = 12 noon.

items.q: Ahmad’s family arrives at East Coast Park at 11.20 am. They stay for 2 h. What time do they leave?
items.e: Add 2 h: 1.20 pm. After 12 noon the time changes from am to pm.

items.q: Mr Tan’s dinner party ends at 8.10 pm. It lasts 1 h 45 min. What time did it start?
items.e: Count back 1 h: 8.10 pm → 7.10 pm. Count back 10 min to 7.00 pm. 45 − 10 = 35 min more takes you back to 6.25 pm. Check: 6.25 pm + 1 h 45 min = 8.10 pm.

items.q: Nurul starts a jigsaw puzzle at 7.55 am. She takes 1 h 20 min. What time does she finish?
items.e: Add 1 h first: 7.55 am → 8.55 am. Then add 20 min: 8.55 am → 9.00 am → 9.15 am.

items.q: Ethan’s family leaves home at 10.35 am. They drive for 1 h 50 min to a resort in Malaysia. What time do they arrive?
items.e: Add 1 h first: 10.35 am → 11.35 am. Then add 50 min: 11.35 am → 12 noon → 12.25 pm. After 12 noon the time changes from am to pm.

items.q: What is 12 noon in 24-hour time?
items.e: 12 noon is the middle of the day. In 24-hour time it is 1200. (0000 is 12 midnight.)

items.q: What is 12 midnight in 24-hour time?
items.e: A new day starts at 12 midnight. In 24-hour time we write 0000. (1200 is 12 noon.)

items.q: Write 7.30 am in 24-hour time.
items.e: am times keep the same hour. A 24-hour time always has 4 digits, so put a 0 in front: 0730. (1930 is 7.30 pm.)

items.q: Write 9.05 am in 24-hour time.
items.e: am time, so the hour stays 9. Write 4 digits: 09 for the hour and 05 for the minutes: 0905. (0950 would be 9.50 am.)

items.q: Write 3.00 pm in 24-hour time.
items.e: For pm times, add 12 to the hour: 3 + 12 = 15. So 3.00 pm = 1500. (1300 adds 10, not 12. 0300 is 3.00 am.)

items.q: Write 7.30 pm in 24-hour time.
items.e: pm time, so add 12 to the hour: 7 + 12 = 19. So 7.30 pm = 1930. (1730 adds 10, not 12. 2130 is 9.30 pm.)

items.q: Which 24-hour time is in the morning?
items.e: Times from 0000 to 1159 are am times. 0815 is 8.15 am, in the morning. 1815 is 6.15 pm, 2015 is 8.15 pm and 1215 is 12.15 pm.

items.q: Write 1930 in 12-hour time.
items.e: 19 is more than 12, so it is a pm time. 19 − 12 = 7. So 1930 = 7.30 pm. (Not 9.30 pm: do not just read the 9. Take away 12, not 10.)

items.q: Write 1500 in 12-hour time.
items.e: 15 − 12 = 3, and it is after noon. So 1500 = 3.00 pm. (5.00 pm takes away 10, not 12.)

items.q: Write 11.45 pm in 24-hour time.
items.e: pm time, so add 12 to the hour: 11 + 12 = 23. So 11.45 pm = 2345. (2145 adds 10, not 12. 1145 is 11.45 am.)

items.q: Write 2105 in 12-hour time.
items.e: 21 − 12 = 9, and it is after noon. So 2105 = 9.05 pm. (11.05 pm takes away 10, not 12. 9.50 pm mixes up 05 and 50.)

items.q: Write 12.20 pm in 24-hour time.
items.e: 12.20 pm is 20 min after 12 noon. Noon is 1200, so do not add 12: 1220. (There is no 2420. 0020 is 20 min after midnight.)

items.q: Write 1645 in 12-hour time.
items.e: 16 − 12 = 4, and it is after noon. So 1645 = 4.45 pm. (6.45 pm takes away 10, not 12.)
The short hand is between 6 and 7, and the long hand points to 8: 6.40. In the evening it is 6.40 pm. 6 + 12 = 18, so it is 1840. (0640 is in the morning. 1640 adds 10, not 12.)
The short hand is between 9 and 10, and the long hand points to 5: 9.25. In the morning it is am, so the hour stays 9: 0925. (2125 is 9.25 pm. 0525 reads the long hand as the hour.)

items.q: Write 12.40 am in 24-hour time.
items.e: 12.40 am is 40 min after 12 midnight. Midnight is 0000, so 12.40 am = 0040. (1240 is 12.40 pm, just after noon.)

items.q: Write 1210 in 12-hour time.
items.e: 12 is the noon hour, so do not take away 12. 1210 is 10 min after 12 noon: 12.10 pm. (12.10 am is just after midnight.)

items.q: The digital clock shows 24-hour time. What is the time in 12-hour time?
items.e: 14 − 12 = 2, and it is after noon. So 1415 = 2.15 pm. (4.15 pm takes away 10, not 12.)

items.q: Which is the latest time in a day?
items.e: In 24-hour time a bigger number is later in the day. 2110 (9.10 pm) is the latest. 1545 is 3.45 pm, 1205 is 12.05 pm and 0950 is 9.50 am.

items.q: How long is it from 0945 to 1320?
items.e: 0945 to 1000 is 15 min. 1000 to 1300 is 3 h. 1300 to 1320 is 20 min. 15 min + 3 h + 20 min = 3 h 35 min. (3 h 75 min comes from 1320 − 945 = 375, but 1 h has 60 min, not 100.)

sets.title: Time word problems with bar models

items.q: School starts at 7.30 am. Wei Ming leaves home at 7.05 am. How much time does he have to get to school?
items.e: 7.05 am to 7.30 am is 25 min.

items.q: Priya boards an MRT train at 3.50 pm. The ride takes 25 min. What time does she reach her station?
items.e: From 3.50 pm, 10 min takes you to 4.00 pm. 25 min − 10 min = 15 min more makes 4.15 pm.

items.q: Recess lasts 30 min. It ends at 10.00 am. What time does recess start?
items.e: Count back 30 min from 10.00 am: 9.30 am. Check: 9.30 am + 30 min = 10.00 am.
The clock shows 7.12 am. 7.12 am to 7.30 am is 30 − 12 = 18 min. (12 min is just the minutes on the clock. 42 min adds 30 and 12.)

items.q: A movie starts at 7.45 pm. It lasts 1 h 50 min. What time does it end?
items.e: Add 1 h first: 7.45 pm → 8.45 pm. Then add 50 min: 8.45 pm → 9.00 pm → 9.35 pm.

items.q: Sarah leaves home at 6.55 am. She walks 10 min to the MRT station. Then the train ride takes 25 min. What time does she reach her stop?
items.e: Walk: 6.55 am + 10 min = 7.05 am. Train: 7.05 am + 25 min = 7.30 am. (7.05 am stops after the walk. 7.20 am adds only the train ride.)

items.q: Kavya runs two rounds of the school field. The first round takes 1 min 45 s. The second round takes 1 min 30 s. How long does she take altogether?
items.e: Add the minutes: 1 min + 1 min = 2 min. Add the seconds: 45 s + 30 s = 75 s = 1 min 15 s. 2 min + 1 min 15 s = 3 min 15 s. (2 min 15 s forgets to rename 60 s as 1 min.)

items.q: An MRT train stops at 4 stations. It stops for 40 s at each station. How long does it stop altogether?
items.e: 4 × 40 s = 160 s. 160 s = 60 s + 60 s + 40 s = 2 min 40 s. (1 min 60 s counts 1 min as 100 s.)

items.q: Hafiz spends 45 min on his homework. Siti spends 20 min more than Hafiz. How long do they spend altogether?
items.e: Siti: 45 + 20 = 65 min. Altogether: 45 + 65 = 110 min. 110 min = 60 min + 50 min = 1 h 50 min. (1 h 5 min is only Siti’s time. 1 h 10 min counts 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: Ali takes the MRT and then a bus to his grandmother’s flat. The whole journey takes 1 h 10 min. The bus ride takes 25 min. How long is the MRT ride?
items.e: 1 h 10 min = 60 + 10 = 70 min. 70 − 25 = 45 min. Check: 45 min + 25 min = 70 min = 1 h 10 min. (85 min counts 1 h as 100 min. 1 h 15 min takes 10 from 25 instead of renaming.)

items.q: School starts at 7.30 am and ends at 1.30 pm. How long is the school day?
items.e: 7.30 am to 8.00 am is 30 min. 8.00 am to 1.00 pm is 5 h. 1.00 pm to 1.30 pm is 30 min. 30 min + 5 h + 30 min = 6 h. (7 h counts the numbers 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 1 instead of the jumps.)

items.q: A movie starts at 1945 and ends at 2135. How long is the movie?
items.e: 1945 to 2000 is 15 min. 2000 to 2100 is 1 h. 2100 to 2135 is 35 min. 15 min + 1 h + 35 min = 1 h 50 min. (190 min comes from 2135 − 1945, but 1 h has 60 min, not 100.)

items.q: A hawker stall opens at 6.30 am. It stays open for 9 h. What time does it close?
items.e: Add 9 h: 3.30 pm. After 12 noon the time changes from am to pm.

items.q: Mei Ling’s flight leaves Changi Airport at 0815. She reaches the airport 2 h 30 min before that. What time does she reach the airport? Give the 24-hour time.
items.e: Count back 2 h: 0815 → 0615. Count back 30 min more: 0615 → 0600 is 15 min, then 15 min more is 0545. (1045 counts forwards. 0615 forgets the 30 min.)

items.q: Chloe’s family visits the Singapore Zoo from 9.15 am to 1.40 pm. How long are they at the zoo?
items.e: 9.15 am to 10.00 am is 45 min. 10.00 am to 1.00 pm is 3 h. 1.00 pm to 1.40 pm is 40 min. 45 min + 3 h + 40 min = 4 h 25 min. (8 h 25 min comes from 9 − 1 = 8, but that does not work across 12 noon.)

items.q: Devi has a 45 min piano lesson every week. How long are 4 lessons altogether?
items.e: 1 unit = 45 min. 4 units = 4 × 45 = 180 min. 180 min = 60 + 60 + 60 = 3 h. (1 h 80 min counts 1 h as 100 min.)

items.q: A movie starts at 2.40 pm and ends at 4.25 pm. Ryan reaches the cinema 15 min before the movie starts. How long is he at the cinema until the movie ends?
items.e: Ryan arrives 15 min before 2.40 pm, at 2.25 pm. 2.25 pm to 4.25 pm is 2 h. (1 h 45 min is only the movie. 1 h 30 min takes away the 15 min instead of adding it.)

items.q: Mr Kumar takes 2 h 20 min to paint a room. Mrs Kumar takes 35 min less. How long does Mrs Kumar take?
items.e: 2 h 20 min = 1 h 80 min (rename 1 h as 60 min: 60 + 20 = 80). 80 − 35 = 45. So Mrs Kumar takes 1 h 45 min. (2 h 15 min takes 20 from 35. 2 h 55 min adds instead of subtracts.)

items.q: A National Day show on TV starts at 1745. It lasts 2 h 30 min. What time does it end? Give the 24-hour time.
items.e: Add 2 h: 1745 → 1945. Add 30 min: 1945 → 2000 is 15 min, then 15 min more is 2015. (1915 adds only 1 h 30 min. 0815 is 8.15 am, but the show ends at 8.15 pm, which is 2015.)

items.q: Siti’s MRT ride takes 35 min. Her bus ride takes 1 h 5 min. How much longer is the bus ride?
items.e: 1 h 5 min = 60 + 5 = 65 min. 65 − 35 = 30 min. (70 min counts 1 h as 100 min. 1 h 30 min takes 5 from 35 instead of renaming. 1 h 40 min adds the times.)
